Synopsis:
    Defense lawyers in the Malta trial of businessman Yorgen Fenech — accused of masterminding the 2017 car bomb assassination of journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia — are attempting to shift blame onto former government chief of staff Keith Schembri. The defense challenges the credibility of key state witness Melvin Theuma and argues investigators failed to pursue Schembri as a suspect. Verdict expected next month; Fenech faces life imprisonment if convicted.
